title: Flock user export, LPR policy, and roster request - Holmes County SO

communications.subject: Florida Sunshine Law Request: Flock user export, LPR policy, and roster request - Holmes County SO
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Flock Safety user export. A current export or report from HCSO's Flock Safety administrative console listing every individual with an active or inactive user account/login on HCSO's Flock Safety system, including for each user: full name, agency-issued email address or username, assigned user role or permission level, the date the account was created, and — for any account that has been deactivated, suspended, or removed — the date that occurred.

2. License plate reader / ALPR policy. HCSO's current written policy, general order, standard operating procedure, or other governing document addressing the use of automated license plate readers and/or the Flock Safety system, including any prior versions adopted or in effect at any point since January 1, 2022. Please include any provisions addressing: who may be issued a user account or search access; data retention and deletion; and the sharing of camera-network access or search results with other law-enforcement agencies, state agencies, federal agencies, or any private or non-governmental organization — including, but not limited to, the National Insurance Crime Bureau (NICB) or any private insurance company or insurance-industry trade organization.

3. Current roster/directory of sworn and reserve personnel. A current roster or personnel directory listing every individual holding a sworn law-enforcement commission through HCSO as of the date of this request, including full-time deputies and any part-time, reserve, auxiliary, or special/reserve deputy commissions, showing for each: name, rank or title, and commission/employment status (active or inactive).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Jason Hunyar
